---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the use case or pain point.

**Proposed solution**
How you'd like it to work.

**Success metric (required)**
How we will measure this worked (single primary metric).

**Guardrail metrics (required)**
What must not regress while shipping this.

**Risk class (required)**
Choose one: A (high), B (medium), C (low).

**Rollout plan (required)**
How this will be staged (dev → staging → production, cohorts/percentages if needed).

**Rollback plan (required)**
Exact condition to rollback and exact rollback action.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about.

**Additional context**
Screenshots, mockups, or links to related issues.
